title: The Hand-Cast Net Primer
summary: Teaches a bare-handed beginner to gather and fold and throw a hand net without qi or special strength.

title: Plain Rules of the Throwing Net
summary: Sets out the grip and the cast and the recovery of a thrown net for a student of the Skin stage.

title: Handbook of the Weighted Hem
summary: Shows how the leaded hem of a net is swung and dragged and used as a short lash.

title: Drill-Book for Mesh and Tether
summary: Drills the tethered net through throws and hauls and turns so a Tendon-stage body keeps the cord clear.

title: A Workbook of Hoop and Mesh
summary: Covers the hooped landing net as a close-quarters tool for scooping and pinning and parrying.

title: Treatise on Qi in the Cast Mesh
summary: Introduces the first thread of qi into a thrown net so the cast flies true and the cord holds.

title: Canon of the Lead-Line Throw
summary: Teaches the lead line as a measure of range and a way to reel in a tangled target.

title: Reading the Fall of a Cast Net
summary: Trains a Senior student to judge how a cast net opens and settles and to cinch it at the right moment.

title: First Lessons in the Closing Cord
summary: Presents the purse-cord net that draws shut around a target and the qi-light motions that close it.

title: Handbook of Two Nets and One Cord
summary: Explains carrying two nets on one cord so a second cast follows the first without a pause.
